caption:
Kazakhtelecom has become part of the Gonka community

In early December, we spent a full day in Astana, immersing ourselves in the local IT environment and engaging with the community. Our key interlocutor was Bagdat Mussin, CEO of Kazakhtelecom and Ex-Minister of digitalization of KZ. With his involvement, the country launched several major digital initiatives, including e-government, which today ranks among the top 10 globally

Together with the Astana Hub team, Bagdat and his colleagues organized an introduction to the ecosystem of the hub, meetings with startups founded by Kazakh entrepreneurs, and an open fireside chat

AI, its prospects for the region, and the opportunities it creates for people, business, and the state

Today, we are glad to share that the company has become part of the Gonka network

This marks the first case of a state institution participating in a decentralized compute network of this kind

We are confident this collaboration will continue to develop. This format gives the state access to AI compute without the need to spend billions of dollars on purchasing and coordinating NVIDIA chips or building closed infrastructure from scratch

The race has begun
